Prescription Opioids (Codeine, Hydrocodone): Combining narcotic cough medicines with alcohol carries serious warnings for extreme sedation, slowed breathing, coma, and death. Acetaminophen (Paracetamol): Many multi-symptom cold and cough products contain acetaminophen. Mixing it with alcohol raises the risk of liver damage. Antihistamines & Decongestants: Ingredients often paired with cough remedies can worsen sedation, dizziness, or blood pressure and heart effects when mixed with alcohol.
